source_groups: G287 TikTok Lite terminal package/ARM32 failure
boundary: Package/Resource candidate intake, local host only; no device/build/graph/remote permission action
version_architecture: AOSP16 R4 / OH7 ARM64 Bionic App portfolio
problem: G287 transferred a 35,983,713-byte APK before its ARM32-only native payload was visible and the candidate was rejected. G279 separately shows a cheap preflight can stop before stage.
baseline: G287 page 1.667 s, HEAD 0.365 s, full GET 3.481 s and 35,983,713 bytes, then package mismatch and ARM32-only terminal failure; raw/static count delta zero.
hypothesis: For official APK servers with stable HTTP byte ranges, reading ZIP EOF and central directory before full GET will reject ARM32-only assets with under 1% of full payload transfer, without rejecting an accepted ARM64 control.

options.name: full GET then ZIP and badging
options.tradeoff: authoritative payload checks but incurs entire transfer before ABI rejection

options.name: bounded HTTP Range ZIP directory preflight
options.tradeoff: cheap ABI reject when server supports ranges; parser and remote content identity need careful guards

selected_one_improvement: Add an optional fail-closed ZIP central-directory ABI preflight before full APK GET; only negative ARM32-only classification can stop a candidate. Ambiguous or unsupported ranges fall back to current bounded GET, and positive classification confers no acceptance.
sample: local replay of exact G287 rejected APK and exact G284 accepted Element X APK
cost_cap: local read-only two APKs; no network, graph, device, container or permission mutation
acceptance: Local G287 reject / G284 continue; later live range probe must return 206 with consistent Content-Range and ETag or Last-Modified, fetch under 1% for G287, and match full payload classification.
stop_rollback: Any missing/inconsistent 206 range identity, malformed ZIP, ambiguous ABI, or false rejection of ARM64 control disables preflight and preserves full GET path.
